title: Grayton Gold
meta_description: Find the perfect Grayton Beach, FL vacation rental at “Grayton Gold”, a luxury 5-bed, 5.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 16 guests, this home offers a Private Pool & Golf Cart for your exclusive enjoyment. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights - Gulf views, including a rooftop lookout - 6 Seater Golf Cart and 6 bicycles are included - Private Heated pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $50 per day from October 1 - May 1) - EV Charger - Outdoor Kitchen - Steps to the beach - Elevator Welcome to Grayton Gold — where luxury meets the laid-back soul of Old Florida. Perfectly positioned in the heart of iconic Grayton Beach, this stunning coastal retreat was thoughtfully designed for gatherings of up to sixteen guests. Framed by rolling dunes and just a short stroll to the shoreline, Western Lake, and the beloved Red Bar, it places you at the center of everything that makes Grayton so special. Step inside to a bright, refined interior where herringbone-patterned tile leads to spacious king suites, a custom bunk room, and a fully equipped laundry room with dual washer and dryer sets — perfect for longer stays. The primary suite upstairs is a private sanctuary with floor-to-ceiling windows, a covered balcony with sweeping Gulf views, and a spa-inspired bath featuring Calacatta porcelain tile and a freestanding soaking tub. Designed with groups in mind, the home offers multiple living areas including an upper-level great room with vaulted shiplap ceilings and panoramic water views. The chef’s kitchen boasts a Wolf range, Sub-Zero refrigeration, dual dishwashers, and a generous island ideal for breakfast gatherings or evening cocktails. A wet bar nearby makes it effortless to enjoy morning coffee or nighttime refreshments. Outdoors, the home becomes a true vacation oasis. A private inset pool, covered lanai with lounge seating, mounted TV, built-in grill, and summer kitchen create the perfect backdrop for poolside relaxing or after-beach hangouts. A spiral staircase leads to the rooftop deck, offering 360-degree views of the Gulf and Grayton’s natural landscape — the ideal spot for sunset watching. Guests also enjoy thoughtful conveniences including a Tesla charging station, complimentary bicycles, and a golf cart for effortless trips to beach accesses, shops, and local dining. Blending architectural excellence with coastal comfort, Grayton Gold delivers the ultimate Grayton Beach vacation experience — modern luxury, Old Florida charm, and unforgettable memories. Sleeping Arrangement First Floor King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom Second Floor Master King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower and Soaking Tub Queen over Queen Bunkroom - Private Bathroom with Shower One XL-Twin over XL-Twin Bunk and One Twin over Twin Bunkroom - Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo Third Floor King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower *Garage is not for guest use*
